LiveChannelAudio.description_en:
The container that stores audio stream information when Status is Live.
The Video and Audio containers are returned only when Status is Live. However, these two containers are not always returned when Status is Live. For example, if the client has connected to the LiveChannel but has not sent audio or video data, these two containers are not returned
LiveChannelAudio.description_zh:
当Status为Live时，保存音频流信息的容器。
Video、Audio容器只有在Status为Live时才会返回，但Status为Live时不一定返回这两个容器。例如，客户端已经连接到LiveChannel，但尚未发送音视频数据，这种情况不会返回这两个容器

Bandwidth.description_en:
The bitrate of the current audio stream.
Bandwidth is the average bitrate of the audio or video stream over a recent period of time. When the LiveChannel has just switched to the Live status, the returned Bandwidth value may be 0.
Unit: B/s
Bandwidth.description_zh:
当前音频流的码率。
Bandwidth为音频流/视频流最近一段时间内的平均码率。LiveChannel刚切换到Live状态时，返回的Bandwidth值可能为0。
单位：B/s
Bandwidth.title: description

Codec.description_en: The encoding format of the current audio stream
Codec.description_zh: 当前音频流的编码格式
Codec.title: description

SampleRate.description_en: The sample rate of the current audio stream
SampleRate.title: description

description_en: Retrieves the streaming status of a specified LiveChannel
description_zh: 获取指定LiveChannel的推流状态信息
name: GetLiveChannelStat

schema.description_en: The response body that contains the result of the GetLiveChannelStat operation
schema.description_zh: 保存GetLiveChannelStat返回结果的响应体

LiveChannelStat.description_en: The container that stores the result of the GetLiveChannelStat operation

Audio.description_en:
The container that stores audio stream information. This container is returned only when Status is Live.

The Video and Audio containers are returned only when Status is Live. However, these two containers are not always returned when Status is Live. For example, if the client has connected to the LiveChannel but has not sent audio or video data, these two containers are not returned
Audio.description_zh:
当Status为Live时，保存音频流信息的容器。

Video、Audio容器只有在Status为Live时才会返回，但Status为Live时不一定返回这两个容器。例如，客户端已经连接到LiveChannel，但尚未发送音视频数据，这种情况不会返回这两个容器

ConnectedTime.description_en: The time when the current client started streaming. This element is in ISO 8601 format. This element is returned only when Status is Live
ConnectedTime.description_zh: 当Status为Live时，表示当前客户端开始推流的时间。此元素使用ISO8601格式表示

RemoteAddr.description_en: The IP address of the current streaming client. This element is returned only when Status is Live
RemoteAddr.description_zh: 当Status为Live时，表示当前推流客户端的IP地址

Status.description_en: The current streaming status of the LiveChannel. Valid values: Disabled, Live, Idle
Status.description_zh: LiveChannel当前的推流状态描述。有效值：Disabled、Live、Idle

Video.description_en:
The container that stores video stream information. This container is returned only when Status is Live.

The Video and Audio containers are returned only when Status is Live. However, these two containers are not always returned when Status is Live. For example, if the client has connected to the LiveChannel but has not sent audio or video data, these two containers are not returned

Video、Audio容器只有在Status为Live时才会返回，但Status为Live时不一定返回这两个容器。例如，客户端已经连接到LiveChannel，但尚未发送音视频数据，这种情况不会返回这两个容器
